decision_basis: Two independent Docker canonical-build cycles produced the same zte_tpd.ko SHA-256.
Candidate and stock AArch64 assembly have identical 7 instructions, 28-byte symbol size and resolved relocations.
Candidate and stock KCFI type IDs are identical: 0xe5c47d60.
Strict Joern gate passed with zero parse problems and one-to-one source/Ghidra identity coverage.
The dedicated ASAN/UBSAN harness passed 4/4 tests in both cycles, directly covering the reset position-to-size write, clear, width and repeated-reset behavior.
